column1: # 'Sent in cipher' criteria as a checklist (MQS-WITNESS-LABELS, 9 Oct 2026), after Lasry, Biermann and Tomokiyo 2023,
# Cryptologia 47:2, p.131 n.70-71: a clear copy whose passage refers to the cipher channel, to other cipher letters, or
# makes hostile statements about the host or a third party was likely sent in cipher. Read by
# tools/decode_witness.py --criteria-scan; patterns are Python regexes on the accent-stripped lower-case sentence.
# A hit is a LEAD that the passage may have been in cipher, never a verdict (shelf grade weak: no known answer of its own).
# Patterns are ours, written for this checklist; the three criteria are the paper's.

column5: the cipher, deciphering or a trusted carrier named in the passage
another letter, dispatch or packet in cipher referred to
hostile to the host, the recipient's rivals or a third party named in the passage
